```{python}
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

root=Path.cwd()
while not (root/'.unaltraweb/computations.yml').exists():
    if root==root.parent:raise RuntimeError('No es troba el projecte')
    root=root.parent
out=root/'assets/img/generated/gradient-adiabatic.svg'
out.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
plt.rcParams.update({'font.family':'DejaVu Sans','font.size':13,'svg.fonttype':'none',
                     'axes.spines.top':False,'axes.spines.right':False})
fig,axes=plt.subplots(2,2,figsize=(8.8,8.6),layout='constrained',sharey='row')
height=np.linspace(0,1000,101);temperature=20-.0098*height
ax=axes[0,0]
distance=np.array([0,.5,1,1.5,2,2.5,3]);ground=np.array([0,0,100,350,550,750,500])
ax.fill_between(distance,-50,ground,color='#e9e2d2');ax.plot(distance,ground,color='#7c725f',lw=1.5)
ax.annotate('',(.3,950),(.3,40),arrowprops={'arrowstyle':'->','lw':2,'color':'#006699'})
for h,temp in [(0,20),(500,15.1),(1000,10.2)]:
    ax.scatter(.3,h,s=95,facecolors='white',edgecolors='#006699',lw=2,zorder=4)
    ax.text(.55,h+12,f'{str(temp).replace(".",",")} °C',fontsize=13,color='#006699')
ax.set(xlim=(-.1,3.2),ylim=(-50,1130),ylabel='Altura des de l’inici (m)',xlabel='Distància (km), esquema',
       title='A · Ascens de la mateixa\nparcel·la d’aire')
ax=axes[0,1];ax.plot(temperature,height,color='#006699',lw=2.5)
ax.scatter([20,15.1,10.2],[0,500,1000],color='#006699',zorder=3)
ax.text(.45,.7,'−9,8 °C/km',transform=ax.transAxes,fontsize=14,color='#006699')
ax.set(xlabel='Temperatura (°C)',xlim=(8,22),title='B · Gradient adiabàtic sec\nEscala vertical igual a A')
for ax in axes[0]:ax.set_yticks([0,500,1000]);ax.grid(axis='y',alpha=.2)
z=np.array([0,100,200,300]);t=np.array([30,30,29,27]);b,a=np.polyfit(z,t,1)
r=np.corrcoef(z,t)[0,1]
assert np.isclose(r,-np.sqrt(5/6)) and np.isclose(a,30.5)
ax=axes[1,0];d=np.array([0,.5,1,1.5,2,2.6,3]);ground=np.array([0,65,100,150,200,265,300])
assert np.allclose(np.interp([0,1,2,3],d,ground),z)
ax.fill_between(d,-25,ground,color='#e9e2d2');ax.plot(d,ground,color='#7c725f',lw=1.5)
for i,(position,h,temp) in enumerate(zip([0,1,2,3],z,t),1):
    ax.scatter(position,h,color='#990000',s=55,zorder=3)
    ax.annotate(f'E{i}: {temp} °C',(position,h),xytext=(0,10),textcoords='offset points',
                ha='left' if i==1 else 'right' if i==4 else 'center',fontsize=13)
ax.set(xlim=(-.1,3.2),ylim=(-25,355),xlabel='Distància (km), esquema',ylabel='Altitud (m)',title='C · Quatre estacions\nEmplaçaments diferents')
ax=axes[1,1];ax.scatter(t,z,color='#990000',zorder=3);ax.plot(a+b*z,z,color='#990000',lw=2)
for i,(temp,h) in enumerate(zip(t,z),1):
    ax.annotate(f'E{i}',(temp,h),xytext=(-8,6) if i==1 else (6,6),ha='right' if i==1 else 'left',textcoords='offset points',fontsize=13)
ax.text(.96,.91,'T̂ = 30,5 − 0,01 z\nr = −0,913',transform=ax.transAxes,ha='right',va='top',fontsize=13)
ax.set(xlabel='Temperatura (°C)',xlim=(26,32),title='D · Regressió entre estacions\nEscala vertical igual a C')
for ax in axes[1]:ax.set_yticks([0,100,200,300]);ax.grid(axis='y',alpha=.2)
fig.savefig(out,facecolor='white',metadata={'Date':None})
plt.close(fig)
```
